summary: Tested AUREUS V4 A+ TP-beyond-swing strategy change end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_backtest_v4.py (9 tests) covering /api/validation, /api/signal trade_plan (tp_mode/target_swing/management/RR band), /api/backtest beyond+managed and at+unmanaged, no _id leak, and /api/backtest/report 4Y blocks + 16-instrument grid. All 9 pass. Existing suites also pass: tests/test_strategy.py 4 passed, tests/test_api_endpoints.py 24 passed. Frontend (public URL, 1920x1080): terminal loads, signal panel shows all 7 V4 checks and 'TP beyond swing' in the R:R row, Backtest lower tab renders report-4y with SYNTHETIC banner, Before-vs-After table (TP@swing/TP beyond/+Mgmt), RR distribution bars, 16-card per-instrument grid; 'Run backtest' triggers an on-demand run and renders metric cards. Validation tab shows Suite PASS; journal login (httpOnly cookie) + create/delete works. No blocking defects; several correctness/analysis and auth-hardening issues below.

minor.issue: server.py lines 140 & 230 call S.build_signal() without pip, so pip defaults to 0.0 -> TP buffer is 0 and the target lands EXACTLY on the structural swing. tp_mode='beyond' is a silent no-op on those endpoints (and identical to 'at'). Verified: demo bullish target 113.0 == target_swing 113. Pass pip=D.pip_size(symbol) (or derive pip from symbol inside build_signal).

profit_factor returns 1000000000 when there are zero losses (gross_loss falls back to 1e-9). Frontend prints '1000000000' as a metric card. Return null/'inf' or omit and let UI show the infinity symbol.
Default candles=6000 (~20 days of 5M) yields only ~2 A+ trades for XAU/USD, so the on-demand cards show Win% 100 / PF 1e9. Either raise the default window or surface a 'low sample' warning.
Response duplicates the whole metrics object (nested 'metrics' plus flattened **metrics), inflating payload size; keep one shape.
Key naming inconsistency: per_instrument rows use 'trades' while eurusd blocks use 'total_trades'. Also eurusd.sample_trades is an empty object {} (dead section).
No brute-force lockout: 6 consecutive wrong-password attempts all returned 401 with no 423/429 throttling (auth playbook requires lockout after 5 failures).
CORS_ORIGINS defaults/env-set to '*' while allow_credentials=True. Playbook requires explicit origin list for credentialed cookie auth.

ui_bugs.issue: A full trade plan (Entry/Stop/Target/R:R) is rendered even when status is WAIT and 3 of 7 checks fail (XAU/USD: POI not fresh, no 15M shift, no 10M confirmation). The 'missing' reason banner is suppressed whenever trade_plan exists, so a non-actionable setup looks tradable.
Profit Factor renders raw 1000000000 for a 2-trade, zero-loss on-demand run.

issues: Lower dock is fixed at h-56 with the 4Y report inside, so the per-instrument grid is mostly below the fold and needs scrolling on a 1080p viewport
Report4Y reads report.eurusd.* without guards; if the report schema changes to PENDING/partial the component would throw (only status==='READY' is checked)

action_items: Pass pip into build_signal from /api/signal/demo and /api/ai/explain so TP is truly 'beyond' the swing there
Cap/represent profit_factor when there are no losing trades (avoid 1e9)

Re-examine the headline claim: the 4Y report shows TP-beyond did NOT reduce premature stop-outs (sl_before_tp 51 -> 55; premature 14 -> 13) and win rate was flat (61.27% -> 61.22%). Also before/after trade counts differ (142 vs 147), so it is not a matched-trade comparison - consider evaluating both TP modes on the SAME entry set to make the before/after breakdown meaningful
Add login brute-force lockout (5 failures) and set explicit CORS origins instead of '*' with credentials
Normalise report.json keys (trades -> total_trades) and remove the empty eurusd.sample_trades block
Consider a larger default candle window (or low-sample warning) for the on-demand /api/backtest run
critical_code_review_comments: strategy.py build_signal(pip=0.0) default silently disables the whole TP-beyond feature for any caller that forgets pip - make pip required or derive it from symbol.
backtest.py compute_metrics gross_loss fallback 1e-9 produces a 1e9 profit factor; handle the no-loss case explicitly.

backtest.py _simulate checks stop before target within the same candle (conservative, correct) but the management leg banks the +1R partial before the target check in the same bar, which can slightly overstate managed win rate - the ~90% managed win rate should keep being labelled as non-headline, as the developer already notes.
server.py /api/backtest returns metrics twice; pick a single response contract.
frontend Report4Y destructures report.eurusd blocks without optional chaining on the inner metric keys - add fallbacks.
seed_data_creation: Two journal entries created via the UI during auth/CRUD verification were deleted afterwards (journal is empty again). No other data created.
test_credentials: president@aureus.ai / Aureus2020! (works; bcrypt hash $2b$12$, httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None cookies set on login, seed_admin is idempotent and re-hashes on password change)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests -q -p no:randomly`; test_backtest_v4.py is the V4 TP-beyond regression suite (asserts flattened backtest keys, sl_before_tp/recovered_after_sl booleans, report blocks and 16 instruments). Note test_demo_bullish_plan_beyond deliberately asserts target >= target_swing because /api/signal/demo passes pip=0 - tighten it to '>' once the pip bug is fixed. Synthetic data is intentional; do not flag it.
rca_of_the_issue: TP-beyond placement works where pip is supplied (/api/signal and the backtest, verified target beyond swing for both directions), but call sites that omit pip get a zero-pip buffer, making 'beyond' identical to 'at'. Separately, the 4Y before/after comparison is generated from two independent runs whose RR gate admits different entries, so the SL-before-TP delta (51 -> 55) reflects a different trade population rather than the effect of moving the target.
